name: incoming_merge_source_dropped
description: A base observation (tars T 1.0) plus a stale CARRIED synthesis with source demerzel-merge (variant C) arriving as input. Synthesis is derived cache, not evidence: pipeline step 0 drops incoming demerzel-merge observations and re-derives from surviving base evidence every merge (2026-07-20, GuitarAlchemist/hari#27). The surviving base evidence here has nothing to contradict, so the carried C vanishes and the output is the single T with no contradictions. Without step 0, a synthesis computed from a partial view could survive into states a fresh derivation would never produce.
